name: Home Battery Strategy
info:
The `Home Battery Start` flow will call this strategy flow
by matching the strategy name with the Link In name.

Configure the Link In node in the Start group.

Don't modify other parts of the Start and End groups.
They handle the calling and returning for you.

name: Start (readme)
info:
# Setting up your battery strategy flow

## Setup
Name the `Link In node` in this start group exactly after the <select> option configured in your
select_input.house_battery_strategy

configure select options in:
input_select_house_battery_control.yaml

### example
`house_battery_strategy:
  name: House Battery Strategy
  options:
    - AcmE example`

The above creates a select option, allowing user to select 'AcmE example'

When selected, battery control will search for a flow containing a Link In node
called 'AcmE example' (case sensitive).

name: End (readme)
info:
Should return a solution_array of battery objects

## battery object format
`{{id: string|number, mode: string, power: number}} battery solution`
- id is an arbitrary battery ID
- mode is "stop", "charge", "discharge" for Marstek
- power in Watts

### example array
return this type of solution_array via msg.solutions
` 
let solution_array = [];
solution_array.push({id:"M1", mode: "charge", power: 100}); // per battery
return {solutions: solution_array};
`

name: 📖 How this flow works (open the Info sidebar)
info:
# Strategy Dynamic v2 - how it works

The Start flow calls this tab on **every P1 update** (link in `Dynamic` / `Dynamic 2`).
That fast path does **not** read the period selectors: it runs whatever strategy is cached
in `flow.dynamic_strategy` (via *Has strategy* -> *Set strategy* -> *Sub-strategy*).
An empty cache means **Full stop** (*Set Full stop*).

`flow.dynamic_strategy` is recalculated only by the **Update when** group:

| Trigger | When |
|---|---|
| *Update strat* | every 15 min (and once, 3 s after deploy) |
| *Clear cache* / *Midnight* | 00:01, 13:15 and 15:00 - also re-fetches the prices |
| *User input* | any change of the entities below |

*User input* watches:

- `input_select.house_battery_strategy` (master strategy)
- `input_select.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_data_source`
- `input_number.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_threshold_delta`
- `input_number.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_cheapest_hrs`
- `input_number.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_expensive_hrs`
- `input_select.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_default` - **Baseline / regular period** *(local)*
- `input_select.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_cheapest` - **cheapest period** *(local)*
- `input_select.house_battery_strategy_dynamic_expensive` - **expensive period** *(local)*

## Local change (2026-10-26) - not in upstream HBC v4.15.1

The three period selectors marked *(local)* were added to *User input*.

**Why:** upstream did not watch them, so changing e.g. the regular period from *Full stop*
to another strategy only took effect at the next quarter-hour tick - until then the
batteries kept running the old cached strategy.

**Now:** a change to any period selector recalculates the strategy within a second or two
(prices come from the cache, so no extra API call).

**After an HBC update:** importing a new upstream version of this tab removes the change.
Re-add the three entities to *User input* and Deploy, unless upstream has fixed it.

## Still forces Full stop

`flow.dynamic_strategy` is empty - and the batteries go to **Full stop** whatever the
selectors say - when:

- the tariff data source is *None* (*Set dynamic strategy to null*),
- Node-RED just restarted and no recalculation has run yet,
- no price data came back (*Determine dynamic strategy* shows *No price data*).

info: Local change 2026-10-31: generic hook. Fire the HA event `hbc_refresh_energy_prices` to drop the cached price list and re-run Dynamic straight away, e.g. when the data behind the selected tariff source changes (another bidding zone, a re-configured integration). The flow does not care which source sent it; source-specific triggers live in Home Assistant (see packages/house_battery_control_config.yaml).
